info.title: MDM Merge Operation
info.description: Generic, entity-type-agnostic reversible merge audit log consumed by MergeService. Rows are written only by executeMerge()/reverseMerge() — a runtime audit trail, never seeded. RBAC-scoped and auditable via OpenRegister's object infrastructure (ADR-022) rather than a bespoke app-local log table.

x-openregister.description: Foundational MDM merge-operation register shipped by OpenRegister for the reversible merge engine (x-openregister-merge).

merge-operation.title: Merge Operation
merge-operation.description: Runtime audit log of executed (and reversed) MDM merges. One row per merge.

mergeOperation.title: Merge Operation
mergeOperation.summary: An audit row for one executed (or reversed) merge.
mergeOperation.description: Written exactly once by MergeService::executeMerge() and updated by MergeService::reverseMerge(). Captures the survivor, the merged-away objects, the reason, and a preMergeSnapshot sufficient to restore both objects within the reversal window.

mergedFromUuids.description: UUIDs of the losing objects merged away into the survivor.
mergedFromUuids.title: Merged From

preMergeSnapshot.description: Both objects' golden record, provenance, status and linked source-record ownership, sufficient to restore them on reversal.
preMergeSnapshot.title: Pre-Merge Snapshot

reversible.description: Whether this operation can still be reversed (false once reversed or the window has elapsed).
reversible.title: Reversible

reversedAt.description: Timestamp the merge was reversed, when applicable.
reversedAt.title: Reversed At

reversedBy.description: Acting user uid that reversed the merge, when applicable.
reversedBy.title: Reversed By
